correctness.rationale: The factorization C_t=D(I−tS)^(-1) gives compactness for t<1. A disjoint-interval column reduction proves each compound minor is a nonnegative geometric monomial, giving monotone exterior norms and hence every leading singular-product inequality. A positive Gram Rayleigh argument yields strict first-rank order and a Poisson unitary average yields Ky Fan order and strict p-Schatten order. An explicit weighted Toeplitz counting proof controls finite bandwidth, low-/high-index tails, off-block rank and ℓ¹ truncation errors to obtain the ordered n s_n asymptotic. Its elliptic normalization, critical Schatten membership, logarithmic trace, and t→1 coefficient asymptotic are derived. The included checker ran 2,182 finite diagnostics, which are explicitly not infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparisons of the original generalized Cesàro operator paper, two later same-family sources, and three nearby published mathematical manuscripts do not give the parameterwise all-rank exterior product inequality or the combined full singular-order classification. The general weighted Toeplitz Weyl framework is credited as existing methodology; the symbol-integral specialization alone is not presented as a new general theorem. Equivalence to an unindexed general totally-positive majorization result remains possible.
residual_risks: An older source on total positivity and compound-matrix comparison might already imply the product order under a different name.
The general weighted Toeplitz singular Weyl principle may subsume the displayed coefficient; this is credited as prior methodology, not isolated as standalone novelty.
The 2025 terraced-matrix article was compared through abstract only, not complete full text; it is a different defining matrix.
No independent mathematician has assessed historical priority.

value.rationale: This canonical interpolation from a diagonal compact operator to the noncompact classical Cesàro averaging map preserves every ordinary eigenvalue while changing singular spectra. The all-rank products provide precise natural volume/approximation-order information, stronger than an ordinary operator- or HS-norm calculation, and the exact elliptic asymptotic establishes the critical weak trace and sharp Schatten p=1 boundary with quantified divergence near t=1. The claims form a structural family-wide classification, not a routine isolated matrix evaluation.
